thread:
priya: quick check — ran a lightweight probe across h100/us-west and a100/eu-west for the new llama-70b-q8 build. want to discuss a minimal switchover heuristic before full rollout.

benchbot: probe results uploaded: https://internal/bench/2112345678 (csv + charts). summary: h100 flashv3 q8 p50=38ms p95=92ms tps=210; triton q8 p50=45ms p95=108ms tps=195; vendorlib q8 p50=40ms p95=95ms tps=205. a100 flashv3 q8 p50=68ms p95=150ms tps=120; triton q8 p50=62ms p95=140ms tps=130. region jitter visible in eu-west during 10:30-11:00 window, ~12% p95 swell. csv attached: run_id,region,gpu,kernel,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,tps
2112345678,us-west,h100,flashv3,q8,38,92,210
2112345678,us-west,h100,triton,q8,45,108,195
2112345678,eu-west,a100,flashv3,q8,68,150,120
2112345678,eu-west,a100,triton,q8,62,140,130

ben: thanks — looks like flashv3 wins on H100 latency and throughput, but on A100 it's close and triton wins throughput. how noisy were these?

alice: noise: 3 warmup runs per cell, then 5 steady-state sweeps of 1k requests each. microburst pattern simulated with poisson arrivals; queueing offload disabled.

evan: proposal: make switchover rule per-region+gpu: if p95_degradation > 20% relative to baseline OR tps drop > 15% then flip kernel. add hysteresis window of 10m and require 2 consecutive probes. Thoughts?

priya: I like that. also add a minimum-traffic floor so we don't flip on tiny queues (min 50 qps sample). and prefer flashv3 on H100 unless cost shows otherwise.

cara: can we implement a lightweight heartbeat probe that runs every 5m and only costs a handful of tokens? something like:

```
# probe command (benchbot)
run_probe --model llama-70b-q8 --kernel flashv3,triton,vendor --seq 512 --batch 1 --samples 200 --report-url /tmp/bench.csv
```

benchbot: implemented. next probe scheduled in 5m. provides p50/p95/tps and a tiny eval against a fixed prompt set to sanity-check quality post-quant.

mike: for quality gate: if token-level perplexity dev on probe > baseline + 1.5% then block auto-swap and page eng-ml. we saw subtle q8 regressions before.

ben: operational detail: ensure kernel switchover honors model pins for Dedicated customers. default allowed for hosted only.

priya: action items: (1) benchbot to start heartbeat probes every 5m across both regions (2) eng-ml to add switchover policy: p95 >20% OR tps drop >15%, min 50 qps sample, hysteresis 10m & 2 probes (3) mike to own quality gate threshold and test on the probe prompt set (4) cara to add metric annotation in Console for when kernel flip occurred.

alice: I pushed a small follow-up that adds a metric for "probe_quality_delta" per kernel — will show up in dashboards.

priya: thanks all — if probebot flags anything overnight i'll follow up monday morning. :thumbsup:
